text: 2026-09-26 UI-H review found concrete forgery vectors that only source re-verification can close, since the ledger alone cannot see the source: (1) the v3 ledger's sampleCounts rule (positiveColumn vs derivedFromDuration, and its column name) is not checked against the fixation header; (2) declared attributeColumns are not checked against the inventory header; (3) a keyless rejected record can be listed under any inventory trial in a forged ledger. Re-running the importer on the source and comparing ledgers closes all three.
